note: The legal system and body of law developed in ancient Rome, which influenced many modern civil-law systems.

senses.m: The legal system and body of law developed in ancient Rome, which influenced many modern civil-law systems
senses.pat: Roman law tradition · study Roman law · principles of Roman law
ex: The course traces the influence of Roman law on civil codes.
Khóa học lần theo ảnh hưởng của luật La Mã đối với các bộ luật dân sự.
Roman law distinguished several forms of property.
Luật La Mã phân biệt một số hình thức sở hữu.

note: A nose with a prominent bridge, often slightly curved; an appearance description that can be subjective and should not be used to stereotype.

senses.m: A nose with a prominent bridge, often slightly curved
senses.pat: a Roman nose · a prominent Roman nose · describe a Roman nose
ex: The portrait shows a man with a strong Roman nose.
Bức chân dung vẽ một người đàn ông có sống mũi cao và rõ.
The term Roman nose is an old descriptive expression.
Cụm Roman nose là cách miêu tả kiểu cũ.

note: The temperature of an indoor room; in cooking and science, it is an approximate range rather than a fixed value.

senses.m: The temperature of an indoor room
senses.pat: at room temperature · bring to room temperature · room-temperature butter
ex: Let the butter come to room temperature before mixing.
Để bơ về nhiệt độ phòng trước khi trộn.
Store the sample at room temperature for one hour.
Bảo quản mẫu ở nhiệt độ phòng trong một giờ.

note: A sweet, carbonated North American drink traditionally flavored with roots and herbs; most commercial versions are nonalcoholic.

senses.m: A sweet, carbonated North American drink traditionally flavored with roots and herbs
senses.pat: a glass of root beer · root-beer float · nonalcoholic root beer
ex: He ordered a root beer with his burger.
Anh gọi nước ngọt root beer cùng bánh burger.
They made a root-beer float with vanilla ice cream.
Họ làm root beer float với kem vani.

note: A ladder made from ropes and rungs, designed to be flexible or portable.

senses.m: A ladder made from ropes and rungs, designed to be flexible or portable
senses.pat: climb a rope ladder · lower a rope ladder · emergency rope ladder
ex: The crew lowered a rope ladder to the rescue boat.
Thủy thủ thả thang dây xuống xuồng cứu hộ.
The children climbed the rope ladder at the playground.
Bọn trẻ leo thang dây ở sân chơi.

note: The fruit of a rose plant, often used in teas, jams, or supplements; it contains seeds and varies by species.

senses.m: The fruit of a rose plant, often used in teas, jams, or supplements
senses.pat: rose-hip tea · harvest rose hips · rose-hip syrup
ex: She made tea from dried rose hips.
Cô pha trà từ quả tầm xuân khô.
Rose hips ripen after the flowers fade.
Quả tầm xuân chín sau khi hoa tàn.

note: A long organized march, especially one used for military training; British English.

senses.m: A long organized march, especially one used for military training
senses.pat: go on a route march · a training route march · complete a route march
ex: The recruits completed a route march through the hills.
Tân binh hoàn thành cuộc hành quân huấn luyện qua vùng đồi.
The route march tested the unit’s endurance.
Cuộc hành quân kiểm tra sức bền của đơn vị.

note: One of a line of attached houses sharing side walls; common in North American English, especially urban areas.

senses.m: One of a line of attached houses sharing side walls
senses.pat: a brick row house · live in a row house · row-house neighborhood
ex: They bought a brick row house near the station.
Họ mua một căn nhà liền kề xây gạch gần nhà ga.
The historic row houses were built in the 19th century.
Dãy nhà liền kề lịch sử được xây vào thế kỷ 19.

note: A tangy, creamy British condiment used on salads and sandwiches; similar to but not identical with mayonnaise.

senses.m: A tangy, creamy British condiment used on salads and sandwiches
senses.pat: a spoonful of salad cream · salad-cream dressing · spread salad cream on
ex: He added salad cream to his sandwich.
Anh phết xốt salad cream lên bánh mì kẹp.
The salad was dressed with salad cream.
Món salad được trộn với xốt kem chua nhẹ.

note: A youthful period of inexperience or carefree idealism; sometimes a time of early success. Usually plural and often preceded by my/her/their.

senses.m: A youthful period of inexperience or carefree idealism
senses.pat: in my salad days · remember one’s salad days · salad days of youth
ex: In her salad days, she traveled with very little money.
Thời trẻ bồng bột, cô đi du lịch với rất ít tiền.
He remembered the salad days of his acting career.
Ông nhớ những ngày đầu đầy hứng khởi trong sự nghiệp diễn xuất.

note: A shallow area or basin where seawater evaporates and salt is collected; also salt pond or saltern.

senses.m: A shallow area or basin where seawater evaporates and salt is collected
senses.pat: a coastal salt pan · salt-pan production · harvest salt from a salt pan
ex: Workers collected salt from the coastal salt pan.
Công nhân thu hoạch muối từ ruộng muối ven biển.
The salt pans attract wading birds.
Các ruộng muối thu hút chim lội nước.

note: A raised area of sand in a river or near a shore, formed by currents; also sandbar.

senses.m: A raised area of sand in a river or near a shore, formed by currents
senses.pat: a shallow sand bar · stranded on a sandbar · cross a sand bar
ex: The boat ran aground on a sand bar.
Con thuyền mắc cạn trên một doi cát.
A sandbar appeared at low tide.
Một doi cát lộ ra khi thủy triều xuống.

note: A small migratory bird that nests in sandy banks; called bank swallow in North America.

senses.m: A small migratory bird that nests in sandy banks
senses.pat: a colony of sand martins · sand-martin nesting site · watch sand martins
ex: Sand martins nested in the riverbank.
Chim én bờ làm tổ trong bờ sông.
The reserve protects nesting sites for sand martins.
Khu bảo tồn bảo vệ nơi làm tổ của chim én bờ.

note: Television transmitted to viewers via communications satellites, usually received through a dish antenna.

senses.m: Television transmitted to viewers via communications satellites, usually received through a dish antenna
senses.pat: subscribe to satellite television · satellite-TV receiver · satellite television service
ex: They use satellite television in the remote village.
Họ dùng truyền hình vệ tinh ở ngôi làng xa xôi.
The storm disrupted satellite television reception.
Cơn bão làm gián đoạn tín hiệu truyền hình vệ tinh.

note: A small vessel with a spout for serving sauce or gravy; also called a gravy boat.

senses.m: A small vessel with a spout for serving sauce or gravy
senses.pat: a silver sauce boat · pour from a sauce boat · sauce-boat stand
ex: The host passed the sauce boat around the table.
Chủ nhà chuyền bình rót xốt quanh bàn.
The sauce boat held warm gravy.
Bình rót xốt đựng nước thịt nóng.

note: To reduce the size, amount, or level of something.

senses.m: To reduce the size, amount, or level of something
senses.pat: scale down production · scale something down by half · be scaled down
ex: The company scaled down the project after funding fell.
Công ty thu hẹp dự án sau khi nguồn vốn giảm.
They scaled the design down to fit the smaller room.
Họ thu nhỏ thiết kế để vừa với căn phòng nhỏ hơn.

note: To increase the size, amount, or level of something, often by expanding a process.

senses.m: To increase the size, amount, or level of something, often by expanding a process
senses.pat: scale up production · scale something up · be ready to scale up
ex: The factory plans to scale up production next year.
Nhà máy dự định tăng quy mô sản xuất vào năm tới.
The pilot program worked and can now be scaled up.
Chương trình thử nghiệm hiệu quả và giờ có thể được mở rộng.

note: A British snack of a boiled egg wrapped in sausage meat, coated in breadcrumbs, and fried or baked; recipes vary.

senses.m: A British snack of a boiled egg wrapped in sausage meat, coated in breadcrumbs, and fried or baked
senses.pat: a Scotch egg · serve Scotch eggs cold · homemade Scotch egg
ex: They packed Scotch eggs for the picnic.
Họ mang trứng bọc xúc xích đến buổi dã ngoại.
The café serves a Scotch egg with mustard.
Quán phục vụ trứng bọc xúc xích với mù tạt.

note: Paper used for rough notes or calculations, not final work; also scrap paper.

senses.m: Paper used for rough notes or calculations, not final work
senses.pat: write on scratch paper · a sheet of scratch paper · use scratch paper for notes
ex: Use scratch paper to work out the calculation.
Dùng giấy nháp để tính toán.
She jotted the phone number on scratch paper.
Cô ghi số điện thoại lên giấy nháp.

note: A filmed audition used to assess how an actor appears and performs on camera; also a technical test of a display screen in computing.

senses.m: A filmed audition used to assess how an actor appears and performs on camera
senses.pat: take a screen test · pass a screen test · screen-test an actor
ex: The studio invited her to take a screen test.
Hãng phim mời cô thử vai trước máy quay.
The technician ran a screen test to check for dead pixels.
Kỹ thuật viên chạy bài kiểm tra màn hình để tìm điểm ảnh chết.
